Case No.28 of 2022 dated 15.11.2022 under Sections 419/420/467/468/120B of the Indian Penal Code  and charge sheet submitted under S  419/420/467/468/120B/413 of the Indian Penal Code  In the matter of : Arijit Pal.

sentences.text:
...for the Peti  Mr. Subhomoy Bhattacharya,
 Mr. Dattatreya Dutta.
...for the

1 . 
Petitioner was on bail earlier.
He failed to appear before the trial court due to ailments.

As a result,
warrant came to be issued.
He was re-
arrested.
Presently, he is in custody for 216 days.

Accordingly,
he prays for bail.
2. Learned Advocate for the State opposes the bail prayer.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner was on bail earlier.
It is contended due to ailments he was unable to appear before the trial court and warrant came to be issued.

Thereafter,
he was re-arrested.
Be that as it may, he is in custody for 216 days.
No prosecution witness has been examined as yet.
There is little possibility of trial concluding in the near future.
4. Under such circumstances, we are inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail subject to conditions.
Signed By : ALOK SETH High Court of Calcutta 19 th of April 2024 11:01:05 AM 5.

Accordingly, the petitioner viz Arijit Pal shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bankura subject to condition that he shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever and on further condition that the petitioner while on bail shall remain within the district of Bankura and report to the Officer-in-charge, Bankura Cyber Arijit Pal vs Unknown on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72211462/
1

sentences.text: Crime Police Station once in a week until further order.

6. In the event the petitioner fails to appear before the trial court without any justifiable cause, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel his bail in accordance with law without further reference to this Court.
7. This application for bail is, thus, disposed of.

(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.) Signed By : ALOK SETH High Court of Calcutta 19 th of April 2024 11:01:05 AM Arijit Pal vs Unknown on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72211462/
